title: Isandro and the Hymn
author: Mara Nystrom
blurb: Noor Montrose, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
